I'm from Santa Barbara, California, and studied Economics at UC Santa Barbara.
Near the end I had to make a decision.
Either finish a minor in Mathematics, or spend a year abroad in the Netherlands.
I chose the latter and haven't regretted it once.

That year turned into a master's in Economics and Financial Research (Econometrics) and then a PhD at Maastricht University.
The Netherlands has become my home away from home.

Somewhere along the way I picked up a serious interest in statistical computing, and I've come to care a lot about how research code gets written.
This includes interests such as

- Open and reproducible science, and open source tools
- Coding practices that hold up in the social sciences
- Privacy and data rights

Outside of work I boulder, hike, play chess, and play disc golf. Every photo on this site comes from one of those.
